study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective study
finding: Obese women with one abnormal value on the 3-hour OGTT had increased risk of LGA neonates, cesarean delivery, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, preterm birth <37 weeks, neonatal respiratory support, and neonatal hyperbilirubinemia compared to those with normal glucose screens.
mod_finding: Obese women with one abnormal value on the 3-hour OGTT had an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to those with normal glucose screens.
